<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>NOTE
7. Bonds, Note Payable and Other Debt (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Interest</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Series A Bonds have an interest rate of <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zGmloVqNqc3b" title="Debt instrument, rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001096" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">6.97</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum. In July 2024, Standard &amp; Poor&#8217;s provided an initial rating for the
Series A Bonds of ilA+.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Interest
on the Series A Bonds is payable semi-annually in arrears on March 31 and September 30 of each year. The interest rate may increase if
certain financial ratios are not achieved, as discussed below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment
Terms</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_902_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zS8ESYj4VSdf" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001098" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The
principal amount of the Series A Bonds is payable in three annual installments due on September 30 of each of the years 2024 through
2026. The first two principal payments are equal to 6% of the original principal amount of the Series A Bonds, and the last principal
payment is equal to the outstanding principal amount of the Series A Bonds.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial
Covenants</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series A Bonds, the Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The application
of the covenants is based on the financial statements of the Company as prepared under the GAAP accounting method. The financial covenants
are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the consolidated equity of the Company (excluding minority rights), as set forth in the Company&#8217;s
financial statements, will not be less than USD <span id="xdx_907_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zd834tNPdZRb" title="Equity excluding minority rights"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001100" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">20</ix:nonFraction></span> million</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the ratio between the Financial Debt and EBITDA shall not exceed 10</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The DSCR shall not be less than 1.05</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Dividend
Restrictions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
long as the Company does not breach any of the Financial Covenants, no distribution restriction shall hinder the Company. If the Company
is in non-compliance one or more of the Financial Covenants, the Company can make a distribution in an amount that does not exceed the
amount required to meet the U.S. legal requirements applicable to REITs.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Increase
in Interest Rate</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
the event that:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The Company&#8217;s bond rating ilA+ or equivalent is lowered</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The financial debt to EBITDA ratio exceeds 8</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
EBITDA to total debt service payments fall below 1.10</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
Consolidated Equity is less than USD $<span id="xdx_904_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_z4DY6gj9Mrka" title="Equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001102" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">30</ix:nonFraction></span> million</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">An
additional rate of <span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zIwaciuAgDy3" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001104" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% will take place per deviation from the financial covenants, with a maximum additions rate not to exceed<span id="xdx_90F_ecustom--MaximumLimitOfInterestRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember_zVeq1jI4zrK5" title="Limit on additions to interest rate"> <ix:nonFraction name="STRW:MaximumLimitOfInterestRate" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_SeriesABondsMember" id="Fact001106" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span>%
above the interest rate determined on the tender.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Security</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has committed not to pledge its assets under general liens without obtaining the consent in advance of the Bond holders. Nevertheless,
The Company is entitled to register specific liens on its properties and also to provide guarantees; and its subsidiaries are entitled
to register liens, including general and specific, on their assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Additional
Bonds</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Inc
Company can issue additional Series A Bonds at any time not to exceed a maximum outstanding of NIS <span id="xdx_903_ecustom--BondsAuthorzied_iI_pn6n6_uNIS_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zMavDXec1X28" title="Bonds authorzied to issue"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:BondsAuthorzied" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001108" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">550</ix:nonFraction></span> million (or $<span id="xdx_909_ecustom--BondsAuthorzied_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesABondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zqTOUNJMNNGb" title="Bonds authorzied to issue"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:BondsAuthorzied" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_SeriesABondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001110" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">174</ix:nonFraction></span> million).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
of Control</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
holders of a majority of the Series A Bonds may accelerate the outstanding balance of the Bonds if the control of the Company is transferred,
directly or indirectly, unless the transfer of control is approved by the holders of a majority of the Series A Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the purpose of this provision, a transfer of control means a change of control of the Company such that the Company has a controlling
stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members are the beneficiaries under
and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Series
B Bonds</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

In June 2025, Standard &amp; Poor&#8217;s provided an initial rating for the
Series B Bonds of ilA+.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Interest
on the Series B Bonds is payable semi-annually in arrears on June 30 and December 31 of each year. The interest rate may increase if
certain financial ratios are not achieved, as discussed below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment
Terms</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zBFHfh5DXSEf" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001134" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The
principal amount of the Series B Bonds is payable in four annual installments due on June 30 of each of the years 2026 through 2029.
The first three principal payments are equal to 4% of the original principal amount of the Series B Bonds, and the last principal payment
is equal to the outstanding principal amount of the Series B Bonds.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series B Bonds, the Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The application
of the covenants is based on the consolidated financial statements of the Company as prepared under the GAAP accounting method. The financial
covenants are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
On the last day of each calendar quarter, the consolidated equity of the Company (excluding minority rights), as set forth in the Company&#8217;s
consolidated financial statements, will not be less than USD <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zFe3S1qARogf" title="Equity excluding minority rights"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001136" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">20</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

On the last day of each calendar quarter, the ratio between the Financial Debt and EBITDA shall not exceed 10</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Dividend

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
long as the Company does not breach any of the Financial Covenants, no distribution restriction shall hinder the Company. If the Company
is in non-compliance with one or more of the Financial Covenants, the Company can make a distribution in an amount that does not exceed
the amount required to meet the U.S. legal requirements applicable to REITs.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
the event that:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The Company&#8217;s bond rating ilA+ or equivalent is lowered</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">An
additional rate of <span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_zJXyfifZZpHd" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001140" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% will take place per deviation from the financial covenants, with a maximum additions rate not to exceed <span id="xdx_90C_ecustom--MaximumLimitOfInterestRate_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_z0JfZfbyA2sc" title="Limit on additions to interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:MaximumLimitOfInterestRate" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001142" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span>%
above the interest rate determined on the tender.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Security</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company has committed not to pledge its assets under general liens without obtaining the consent in advance of the Bond holders. Nevertheless,
The Company is entitled to register specific liens on its properties and also to provide guarantees; and its subsidiaries are entitled
to register liens, including general and specific, on their assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Additional
Bonds</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Inc
Company can issue additional Series B Bonds at any time and the series does not have a formal ceiling. However, the new issuances are
subject to regulatory oversight.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Redemption
Provisions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Company may, at its discretion, call the Series B Bonds for early repayment. In the event of the redemption of all of the Series B Bonds,
the Company would be required to pay the highest of the following amounts:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
the market value of the balance of the Series B Bonds in circulation which will be determined based on the average closing price of the
Series B Bonds for thirty (30) trading days before the date on which the board of directors resolves to undertake the early redemption;
or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
the par value of the Series B Bonds available for early redemption in circulation (i.e., the principal balance of the Series B Bonds
plus accrued interest until the date of the actual early redemption); or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
the balance of the payments under the Series B Bonds (consisting of future payments of principal and interest), when discounted to their
present value based on the annual yield of the Israeli government bonds plus an &#8220;additional rate&#8221; of <span id="xdx_90E_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesBBondsMember_z6edd5HOdf55" title="Prepayment additional rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateDuringPeriod" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesBBondsMember" id="Fact001144" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">3.0</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
of Control</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
holders of the majority of the Series B Bonds may accelerate repayment of the outstanding balance of the Bonds if the control of the
Company is transferred, directly or indirectly, unless the transfer of control is approved by the holders of a majority of the Series
B Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the purpose of this provision, a transfer of control means a change of control of the Company such that the Company has a controlling
stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members
are the beneficiaries under and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Series
C Bonds</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
July 2021, the BVI Company completed an initial offering on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange (&#8220;TASE&#8221;) of Series C Bonds with a
par value of NIS <span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn5n6_uNIS_c20210701__20210731__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zopbLfNYL4C2"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2021-07-012021-07-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001145" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">208.0</ix:nonFraction></span> million ($<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt_pn5n6_c20210701__20210731__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zDIaVnkhswvb" title="Bonds face amount"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:ProceedsFromIssuanceOfDebt" contextRef="From2021-07-012021-07-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001147" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-5" scale="6" unitRef="USD">64.7</ix:nonFraction></span> million). These Series C Bonds were issued at par. Offering and issuance costs of approximately

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>NOTES

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: center"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>NOTE
7. Bonds, Note Payable and Other Debt (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Series
C Bonds (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Interest</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Series C Bonds initially bore interest at a rate of <span id="xdx_900_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_ziY3VY14zMhi" title="Debt instrument, rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateStatedPercentage" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001162" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">5.7</ix:nonFraction></span>% per annum. In July 2021, Standard &amp; Poor&#8217;s provided an initial rating
for the Series C Bonds of ilA+.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Interest
on the Series C Bonds is payable semi-annually in arrears on July 31 and January 31 of each year. The interest rate may increase if certain
financial ratios are not achieved, as discussed below.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment
Terms</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zOxtjE6AODwa" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001164" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The
principal amount of the Series C Bonds is payable in five annual installments due on July 31 of each of the years 2022 through 2026.
The first four principal payments are equal to 6% of the original principal amount of the Series C Bonds, and the last principal payment
is equal to the outstanding principal amount of the Series C Bonds.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial
Covenants</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series C Bonds, the BVI Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The application
of the covenants is based on the financial statements of the BVI Company as prepared under the IFRS accounting method. The financial
covenants are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company may not be less than $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zD5J2Ok8bcii" title="Equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001166" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">230</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the condensed consolidated stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company to its total condensed consolidated balance sheet
may not be less than <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zdWTqoYaK0g7" title="Stockholder's equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001168" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the adjusted net financial debt to adjusted EBITDA of the BVI Company (for the past four quarters) may not exceed 12.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the outstanding amount of the Series C Bonds to the fair market value of the collateral may not exceed <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--FairMarketValueOutstandingAmountRatio_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zQ0Q5JJH1wYb" title="Fair market value of collateral"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:FairMarketValueOutstandingAmountRatio" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001170" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">75</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

7. Bonds, Note Payable and Other Debt (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Series
C Bonds (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Dividend
Restrictions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
indenture for the Series C Bonds limits the amount of dividends that may be paid by the BVI Company to the Operating Partnership. The
BVI Company may not make any distribution unless all of the following conditions are fulfilled (with all amounts calculated under IFRS):</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The distribution amount may not exceed <span id="xdx_900_ecustom--DividendDistributionAmountPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zz2ZePuoo0E2" title="Dividend distribution percentage ratio"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:DividendDistributionAmountPercentage" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001172" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">80</ix:nonFraction></span>% of the net profit after tax that is recognized in the most recent condensed consolidated financial
statements of the BVI Company, less profits or losses arising from a change in accounting methods, net of revaluation profits/losses
(that have not yet been realized) arising from a change in the fair value of the assets with respect to the fair value in the prior reporting
period.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the consolidated stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company to its total consolidated balance sheet may not be less than
<span id="xdx_901_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_ziBLhibcu5u2" title="Stockholder's equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001174" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">30</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The distributable profits for which no distribution was performed in a specific year will be added to the following quarters.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The BVI Company&#8217;s equity at the end of the last quarter, before the distribution of dividends, less the dividends distributed,
may not be less than $<span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_zbeovN9Kzbn6" title="Stock holder's  equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001176" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">250</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">As
of March 31, 2026, the BVI Company met these financial conditions, and the BVI Company was not in violation of any of its material undertakings
to the holders of the Series C Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Increase
in Interest Rate</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
the event that:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(i)
the stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company (excluding minority interests) is less than $<span id="xdx_901_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquity_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_z5WcIxAuQVo1" title="Equity excluding minority rights"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquity" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001178" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">250</ix:nonFraction></span> million;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(ii)
the ratio of the adjusted net financial debt to adjusted EBITDA (for the latest four quarters) exceeds 11;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iii)
the ratio of the consolidated equity of the BVI Company to total consolidated assets of the BVI Company is below <span id="xdx_900_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember_zsv1iExepyD2" title="Stockholders' equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember" id="Fact001180" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">27</ix:nonFraction></span>%; or</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">(iv)
the ratio of outstanding amount of the Series C Bonds to the fair market value of the collateral for the Series C Bonds exceeds <span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--FairMarketValueOutstandingAmountRatio_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_z3LFtTlz0M89" title="Fair market value of collateral"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:FairMarketValueOutstandingAmountRatio" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001182" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">75</ix:nonFraction></span>%,</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">then,
in each case, the interest on the Series C Bonds will increase by an additional <span id="xdx_906_ecustom--AdditionalInterestIncreaseOnBonds_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember_zfmuAzVO2DNi" title="Interest increasing in additional percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:AdditionalInterestIncreaseOnBonds" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001184" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% annually, but only once with respect to each failure
to meet these requirements. Compliance with these financial covenants is measured quarterly.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Additionally,

by <span id="xdx_908_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_zBuPy8rzimx1" title="Interest rate penalty"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001186" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">0.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% per year, up to a maximum increment of <span id="xdx_90C_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zV8VuX6alVpd" title="Increase in interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateIncreaseDecrease" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_srt_MaximumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember" id="Fact001188" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.25</ix:nonFraction></span>% annually.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">In
any case, the total increase in the interest rate as a result of the above adjustments will not exceed <span id="xdx_903_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage_iI_pid_dp_uPure_c20260331__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zsii1qHgzo1g" title="Limit on additions to interest rate"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentInterestRateEffectivePercentage" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001190" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">1.5</ix:nonFraction></span>% per year. The increases in
the interest rate will also be reversed if the BVI Company regains compliance.</span></p>

7. Bonds, Note Payable and Other Debt (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b>Series
C Bonds (Cont.)</b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Security</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
Series C Bonds are secured by first mortgage liens on nine properties. In addition, the Series C Bonds are also secured by interest and
expenses reserves. The BVI Company has agreed not to pledge its assets pursuant to a general lien without obtaining the prior consent
of the holders of the Series C Bonds, provided that the BVI Company is entitled to register specific liens on its properties and also
to provide guarantees and its subsidiaries are entitled to register general and specific liens on their assets.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_909_eus-gaap--LineOfCreditFacilityCollateral_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember_zrJ9jRGflSH7" title="Collateral description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001192" name="us-gaap:LineOfCreditFacilityCollateral">Under
the terms of the indenture for the Series C Bonds, the BVI Company can take out properties from the collateral (in case of HUD refinancing)
or to add properties and increase the Series C Bonds as long as the ratio of outstanding amount of the Series C Bonds to fair market
value of the collateral is not more than 65%. In addition, starting from July 1, 2023, if the fair market value of the collateral is
below 55%, the BVI Company can request to release collateral so the fair market value will increase to 55%.</ix:nonNumeric></span></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Additional
Bonds</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
BVI Company can issue additional Series C Bonds at any time not to exceed a maximum outstanding of NIS <span id="xdx_905_ecustom--BondsAuthorzied_iI_pn6n6_uNIS_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zOAB0Bge8jXd"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:BondsAuthorzied" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001193" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="NIS">630</ix:nonFraction></span> million (or $<span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--BondsAuthorzied_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesCBondsMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MaximumMember_zibhZ3Ye7ARd"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:BondsAuthorzied" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesCBondsMember_srt_MaximumMember" id="Fact001194" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">199</ix:nonFraction></span> million).</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Redemption
Provisions</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
BVI Company may, at its discretion, call the Series C Bonds for early repayment. In the event of the redemption of all of the Series
C Bonds, the BVI Company would be required to pay the highest of the following amounts:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 0.5in"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
of Control</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">The
holders of a majority of the Series C Bonds may accelerate the outstanding balance of the Bonds if the control of the BVI Company is
transferred, directly or indirectly, unless the transfer of control is approved by the holders of a majority of the Series C Bonds.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
purposes of the Series C Bonds, the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; of the BVI Company are deemed to be Moishe Gubin and Michael
Blisko.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Change
of Control (Cont.)</i></b></span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">For
the purpose of this provision, a transfer of control means a change of control of the BVI Company such that the BVI Company has a controlling
stockholder that is not any of the &#8220;controlling stockholders&#8221; and/or is in the hands of any of their immediate family members
(including through trusts that the controlling stockholders and/or any of their immediate family members are the beneficiaries under
and/or are their managers). In this regard, &#8220;control&#8221; is defined in the Israeli Companies Law.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Payment

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><span id="xdx_90A_eus-gaap--DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms_pid_c20260101__20260331__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zE4vSJe8fcLe" title="Payment terms description"><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001231" name="us-gaap:DebtInstrumentPaymentTerms">The

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt"><b><i>Financial

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">Until
the date of full repayment of the Series D Bonds, the BVI Company must comply with certain financial covenants described below. The application
of the covenants is based on the financial statements of the BVI Company as prepared under the IFRS accounting method. The financial
covenants are as follows:</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company may not be less than $<span id="xdx_90F_eus-gaap--StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest_iI_pn6n6_c20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zMei4XhnHUic" title="Equity"><ix:nonFraction name="us-gaap:StockholdersEquityIncludingPortionAttributableToNoncontrollingInterest" contextRef="AsOf2026-03-31_custom_SeriesDBondsMember_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember" id="Fact001233" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="-6" scale="6" unitRef="USD">230</ix:nonFraction></span> million.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the condensed consolidated stockholders&#8217; equity of the BVI Company to its total condensed consolidated balance sheet
may not be less than <span id="xdx_90B_ecustom--StockholdersEquityPercentage_pid_dp_uPure_c20260101__20260331__srt--RangeAxis__srt--MinimumMember__dei--LegalEntityAxis__custom--BVICompanyMember__us-gaap--DebtInstrumentAxis__custom--SeriesDBondsMember_zZhLuOr476l2" title="Stockholder's equity percentage"><ix:nonFraction name="STRW:StockholdersEquityPercentage" contextRef="From2026-01-012026-03-31_srt_MinimumMember_custom_BVICompanyMember_custom_SeriesDBondsMember" id="Fact001235" format="ixt:numdotdecimal" decimals="INF" scale="-2" unitRef="Pure">25</ix:nonFraction></span>%.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#9679;
The ratio of the adjusted net financial debt to adjusted EBITDA of the BVI Company (for the past four quarters) may not exceed 12.</span></p>

<p style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt; padding: 0pt; text-align: justify"><span style="font-family: Times New Roman, Times, Serif; font-size: 10pt">&#160;</span></p>
